races.name: Bath & West Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Sogna In Grande
runners_data.note: Lightly raced with unknown tactical approach but holds highest OR of 115 suggesting significant ability

runners_data.name: Grand Vendetta
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who should benefit from expected strong early pace between the two leaders

runners_data.name: Catwalk Girl
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner but recent form shows vulnerability when challenged for the lead

runners_data.name: Amatchmadeinheaven
runners_data.note: Natural leader with proven form on good going, showing 2 wins from 3 similar conditions

runners_data.name: Sure To Be Sure
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with mixed going record but tactical style suits if pace is strong early

races.paceDynamic: Catwalk Girl and Amatchmadeinheaven will contest the early lead with both horses showing confirmed front-running tendencies. This will create an honest gallop from the start, potentially setting up the race for Grand Vendetta and Sure To Be Sure to come from off the pace, while the lightly-raced Sogna In Grande remains the tactical unknown.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders settle into a rhythm without over-racing
scenarios.body: The pace will be fair but not destructive, allowing the front two to stay involved deep. Amatchmadeinheaven's proven ability on similar going gives him the edge over Catwalk Girl.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Catwalk Girl and Amatchmadeinheaven battle from flag to finish
scenarios.body: The relentless pace will set up perfectly for Grand Vendetta's prominent style and Sure To Be Sure's hold-up tactics. Both closers will have every chance to pick up the pieces late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If Sogna In Grande shows improved tactics from his lightly-raced profile
scenarios.body: The unknown quantity could benefit from race fitness while others clash early or struggle with positioning. His higher OR suggests untapped potential if connections have found the key.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: One Leader Dominates Early
scenarios.trigger: If either Catwalk Girl or Amatchmadeinheaven gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: The lone leader will dictate terms and prove hard to catch, particularly if it's Amatchmadeinheaven given his superior going record. The field will struggle to close the gap over this staying trip.

watchPoints.text: Catwalk Girl and Amatchmadeinheaven could burn each other out if they engage in sustained early battle
Sure To Be Sure's mixed going form includes poor runs on heavy, though good going should suit
Sogna In Grande's tactical approach remains unknown given limited exposed form
Grand Vendetta needs the leaders to go too fast to set up his prominent running style
The 2m5½f trip will test stamina reserves if the early pace becomes too demanding

runners_data.name: Twist Of Fatecatch
runners_data.note: Strong prominent style with proven good going form that suits tactical pressure

runners_data.name: Calme Olympien
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up performer with excellent good going record who thrives on strong pace

runners_data.name: Jena d'Oudairies
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent runner whose good going form suggests conditions will suit

runners_data.name: Geezer Rockstar
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with solid good going record who can sustain a challenge

runners_data.name: Matthias
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who will dictate terms but needs to quicken when pressed

runners_data.name: Gold Link
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist whose good going form is strong but lacks a recent win

runners_data.name: Wispit Twob
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated hold-up runner who needs everything to fall right from the back

races.paceDynamic: Matthias will lead uncontested with four prominent runners (Jukebox King, Twist Of Fatecatch, Jena d'Oudairies, Geezer Rockstar) tracking within striking distance. The sustainable pace favors the hold-up trio of Calme Olympien, Gold Link and Wispit Twob who can unleash late kicks, while the prominent quartet must time their moves perfectly to deny the closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Matthias gets an easy lead and quickens off the bend
scenarios.body: The front-runner kicks clear turning for home while the prominent runners fail to respond quickly enough. Hold-up horses have too much ground to make up despite the sustained gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Pays
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet apply sustained pressure from the back straight
scenarios.body: Matthias cracks under the relentless pace as Twist Of Fatecatch and Geezer Rockstar battle it out. The hold-up horses benefit from the strong gallop but can't quite get there.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly testing and the field comes back to the closers
scenarios.body: Calme Olympien and Gold Link produce trademark late surges as the early leaders pay for their exertions. The winner emerges from the pack with a devastating finishing kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Muddle Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Matthias goes too slow early and bunches the field
scenarios.body: A messy, stop-start pace creates a cavalry charge finish where positioning at the last hurdle proves crucial. The most balanced runner who avoids trouble prevails in a tight finish.

watchPoints.text: Matthias must not be allowed to coast in front as his OR advantage disappears if pressured early
Calme Olympien and Gold Link need a truly-run race to unleash their finishing kicks effectively
Twist Of Fatecatch's ability to sustain pressure on good going could be key to the pace dynamics
The prominent quartet could get in each other's way if they all commit simultaneously
Wispit Twob's low rating means he needs the pace to completely collapse to feature

runners_data.name: Broomfields Cave
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with excellent similar going record (7 from 15) who needs the race to develop into a stamina test

runners_data.name: Muskoka
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose 7 from 15 similar going record lacks wins but shows consistent competitiveness at this level

runners_data.name: Law Of Supply
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose 5 from 12 similar going record includes recent good form but needs tactical race to suit

runners_data.name: Loup De Maulde
runners_data.note: Natural front runner whose 3 from 15 similar going record includes recent wins but needs to handle the pace-setting role

runners_data.name: Ignore The Door
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with limited experience but strong similar going record (2 from 4) who needs gaps to appear late

races.paceDynamic: Loup De Maulde likely takes them along as the most natural front runner, with Golan Loop, Muskoka, and Law Of Supply tracking prominently behind. The strong prominent contingent should create a solid gallop that sets up the race for the hold-up horses Broomfields Cave and Ignore The Door to mount late challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained pace favours leaders
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet maintain a strong gallop throughout the 3m1f trip
scenarios.body: Loup De Maulde and Golan Loop benefit from being positioned closest to a genuine pace. The stamina test eliminates late finishers as the race becomes a test of who can best sustain their effort.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical affair suits closers
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes pedestrian with the prominent horses marking each other
scenarios.body: Broomfields Cave and Ignore The Door get their ideal scenario with plenty left for their finishing kicks. The race becomes a sprint from the last fence with fresh hold-up horses having the edge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midrace acceleration fragments field
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses ups the tempo significantly from halfway
scenarios.body: Muskoka and Law Of Supply, with their proven ability to quicken, benefit most from the change of pace. The sustained kick suits their racing styles better than pure front-running or hold-up tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina sapping reduces field
scenarios.trigger: If the combination of trip and good ground creates an extreme test of staying power
scenarios.body: Broomfields Cave's proven stamina reserves and Golan Loop's consistent form over similar distances give them the edge. Many rivals fail to see out the trip as the pace takes its toll late.

watchPoints.text: Loup De Maulde setting too strong an early pace could compromise his own finishing effort over this demanding trip
Broomfields Cave and Ignore The Door need the pace to be strong enough early to set up their hold-up tactics
Golan Loop's jumping under pressure as he typically races prominently and will need to be accurate when the race develops
Muskoka's ability to find that extra gear when the pace lifts as his record suggests he often finds one too good
The prominent contingent marking each other too closely early could create a stop-start rhythm that suits nobody

runners_data.name: Square Du Roule
runners_data.note: Reliable place-getter on good ground who needs others to set up the race for his late challenge.

runners_data.name: It's A Breeze
runners_data.note: Highest-rated closer with recent winning form who benefits from strong early pace.

runners_data.name: Walkinthepresent
runners_data.note: Recent winner in excellent form whose hold-up style suits if Harry Junior sets honest gallop.

runners_data.name: Lydeard Girl
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer but lacks recent winning form to suggest she can capitalize.

runners_data.name: Harry Junior
runners_data.note: Sole pace-setter whose uncontested lead could prove decisive or costly depending on judgment.

runners_data.name: Stage Show
runners_data.note: Course winner who adopts flexible tactics and represents solid each-way value at longer odds.

races.paceDynamic: Harry Junior stands alone as the confirmed front runner, meaning he'll dictate proceedings at a sustainable gallop without early pressure from pace rivals. The remaining six runners all adopt hold-up tactics, creating a tactical race where positioning at the final turn becomes crucial as they converge behind Harry Junior's honest gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Harry Junior maintains his rhythm and jumps cleanly throughout
scenarios.body: His uncontested lead allows him to control the tempo perfectly, leaving the hold-up brigade with too much ground to make up when they launch their challenges. The lack of early pace pressure plays directly into his hands over this stamina test.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Perfect Hold-Up Storm
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly sedate and multiple closers time their runs perfectly
scenarios.body: The tactical runners converge in a bunch turning for home, creating a cavalry charge finish where class and current form separate the field. Walkinthepresent and It's A Breeze benefit most from this scenario given their recent winning form.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Harry Cracks Late
scenarios.trigger: If Harry Junior's early freedom leads to him going too fast or making jumping errors under pressure
scenarios.body: His uncontested lead becomes a burden as the stamina-sapping trip takes its toll, allowing the fresher hold-up horses to sweep past in the final half-mile. The highest-rated closer It's A Breeze capitalizes on Harry Junior's decline.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Harry Junior falls or refuses early, leaving no pace-setter
scenarios.body: The race becomes a stop-start affair with reluctant pace-makers among the hold-up specialists, creating an unsatisfactory test that favors the most adaptable. Stage Show's recent course win suggests tactical flexibility that could exploit the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Harry Junior's jumping under pressure - any mistake amplifies when leading alone and could end his chances instantly.
The pace through the middle section - if Harry Junior goes too slow, it negates the stamina test and favors sprint finishers.
Walkinthepresent's position turning for home - recent winner needs to be handy enough to capitalize on his current form.
It's A Breeze's tracking position - needs to avoid getting buried among the hold-up horses when they all make their moves.
Stage Show's early positioning - course advantage means little if he gets too far back in this tactical affair.

races.paceDynamic: Rangatira Jack will take them along from the front with Hatos and My Rockstar likely to track him in the early stages, creating a sustainable gallop rather than a burn-up. With five hold-up horses including the class acts Move With The Beat and Kingcormac, this sets up perfectly for a strong-finishing conclusion where the pace will quicken significantly from the home turn.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Rangatira Jack maintains a solid tempo without getting into a speed duel early
scenarios.body: The pace stays honest throughout allowing the front rank to stay competitive deep into the race. The hold-up horses get their chance but can't quite reel in the prominent runners who've conserved energy.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Acts Deliver
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly testing from three out and the race develops into a proper stamina test
scenarios.body: Move With The Beat and Kingcormac get the strong gallop they need to show their superior ratings. Their hold-up styles prove decisive as they power past tiring leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If Rangatira Jack goes too fast early or gets pressured by the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainable and the race falls apart for the leaders. The best of the hold-up horses with tactical speed like Applicationofcash can strike, but it becomes a muddling affair.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Rank Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If no one tracks Rangatira Jack closely and he builds a big lead before tying up badly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sit-and-sprint from an impossible position. Only the hold-up horses with the most natural ability can bridge the gap in time.

watchPoints.text: Rangatira Jack must be monitored early - if he goes too fast or gets pressured by Hatos/My Rockstar the race shape changes completely
Move With The Beat needs the pace to be strong enough to set up his finishing kick from the back
Applicationofcash showed course form last time and could be the each-way value if getting first run on the leaders
The jumping quality of the hold-up horses will be crucial as they'll need to be traveling smoothly to mount challenges
Kingcormac's position turning for home will tell the story - he needs to be within striking distance despite his style

races.paceDynamic: Victory Shout will dictate a measured tempo from the front with no obvious challengers for the early lead. Lake Tiberias and Prairie Diamond will track prominently in second and third, creating a sustainable rhythm that should set up the race for the large contingent of hold-up horses including Get In Order, Bread And Butter, and Prince Rhinegold to mount late challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained gallop finish
scenarios.trigger: If Victory Shout maintains a steady tempo without early pressure and the pace doesn't collapse
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run but the hold-up horses with proven stamina get the perfect setup. Get In Order and Bread And Butter benefit most from the strong pace over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runners dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Victory Shout kicks clear turning for home and the pace has been genuinely strong throughout
scenarios.body: Prairie Diamond and Lake Tiberias are perfectly positioned to capitalize on any weakening from Victory Shout. The hold-up horses find themselves with too much ground to make up in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy scramble develops
scenarios.trigger: If Victory Shout gets headed early or the pace becomes stop-start with prominent runners interfering
scenarios.body: The rhythm gets disrupted and horses get unbalanced, creating gaps for opportunistic finishers. Prince Rhinegold and Forest Hills could exploit the chaos with their patient styles proving advantageous.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Collapse and sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Victory Shout goes too slow early and turns it into a sprint finish from the home turn
scenarios.body: The prominent horses get first run but tire quickly, while the freshest hold-up horses sweep past. However, the shorter distance run favors those with tactical pace rather than pure stamina.

watchPoints.text: Victory Shout getting headed or pressed early would completely change the race dynamics and favor different finishers
Walk In The West and Eric Gorcombe both show patterns of fading in the finish which could cost connections in a tight finish
Prairie Diamond tracking Victory Shout closely early could indicate intention to press on and make it a genuine test
Get In Order's position turning for home will be crucial given his need for strong gallop over this trip
Forest Hills jumping fluently will be key given recent heavy ground disappointments affecting confidence
